resources.string: dot-matrix keyboard. l33t styles. swag slang.
○ Not enabled yet: tap the button below and turn on SwagKeys
Applied as you type. Change it any time from the style chip on the keyboard. Passwords, e-mail, URLs and number fields are never styled.

Dictionary entries: %1$d. In chat-style fields a listed word is replaced when you finish it (space, punctuation or enter); press delete right after, or tap UNDO in the strip, to restore what you typed. In search, name and address boxes the slang is only offered in the strip: tap it to apply. Words glued to other text (#tags, @names, web addresses) are left alone. The SWAG pill on the keyboard toggles this: solid pill = automatic, outlined pill = strip only.

Nothing OS uses its NDot typefaces, which Nothing licenses for Nothing brand use only, so they are not bundled. SwagKeys ships Doto, an open-source (SIL OFL 1.1) dot-matrix face in the same style. You can also import any .ttf or .otf font you have the rights to use.
That file is not a usable TrueType/OpenType font

Glyph ripple across the dot grid on every key press, key bounce, pop-up previews, sliding panels, and a decode effect when slang kicks in. Also off whenever Android\'s Remove animations setting is on.

Swipe along the space bar to move the cursor. Swipe left from delete to erase whole words (keep sliding for more). Long-press the emoji key to switch keyboards, the space bar to pick one. Hold an emoji with a dot for skin tones.
Vibrate on key press and repeats
